newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Spanish king arrives on visit to Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Spanish king arrives on visit to Moscow.

text.p: Spanish King Juan Carlos arrived in Moscow on Monday to begin a three-day visit aimed at boosting bilateral economic and political ties.
Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin met the king after he landed at Moscow's government airport, Vnukovo-2.
Later Russian President Boris Yeltsin was expected to host a welcoming ceremony for the Spanish king and his wife, Queen Sofia, in the Kremlin.
Yeltsin is scheduled to hold talks with Juan Carlos on Tuesday.
